item: The runlog walk-cost test times a stand-in walk (row 174)
summary: test_the_walk_is_charged_for_ITS_cost_not_the_whole_beats ran the real psutil child walk, which on a busy macOS runner alone passed the 25 ms budget and backed off. The walk is now a zero-cost stand-in so only the unrelated probe is slow; the test also checks the walk is timed apart from the beat and the next beats are not backed off, so it now catches a backoff charged to the whole beat. Product budget unchanged. Test-only.
